description:
## Why

PKIX-xj81 decomposition, pattern 1 of 6. Verifies that AKI-aware candidate
selection (PKIX-yn3e, already closed) finds the verifying path on the first
DFS pass when two intermediates share the same issuer DN but have different
SubjectPublicKeyInfos.

## What

Pool topology:

```
StressRoot ── signs ── BridgeIntermediateOld   (SKI=key0, same DN)
StressRoot ── signs ── BridgeIntermediateNew   (SKI=key1, same DN)
BridgeIntermediateNew ── signs ── BridgedEE
```

EE.AKI = key1 (must match BridgeIntermediateNew.SKI).

Build steps:

1. Use the PKIX-xj81.1 generator to issue:
   - `BridgeIntermediateOld.crt` and `BridgeIntermediateNew.crt` with the
     same subject DN, different keys, both with `SubjectKeyIdentifier` set
     to their SHA-1-of-SPKI as per RFC 5280 §4.2.1.2 method (1).
   - `BridgedEE.crt` signed by BridgeIntermediateNew, with
     `AuthorityKeyIdentifier::keyIdentifier = BridgeIntermediateNew.SKI`.
2. Commit the three DER fixtures.
3. Test (`tests/bridge_aki.rs`):
   - Pool = both intermediates inserted in the "wrong" order (Old first).
   - `build_path(&ee, &pool, &[anchor])` must succeed.
   - The returned chain must contain `BridgeIntermediateNew`, NOT
     `BridgeIntermediateOld`, verified by comparing the SubjectKeyIdentifier
     in the chain[1] cert against `BridgeIntermediateNew`s expected SKI.
   - `validate_path(...)` must succeed end-to-end.
4. Independent oracle: parse the DER fixtures with x509-cert and inspect the
   AKI/SKI extensions in the test itself; compare the extracted bytes to
   hard-coded hex literals lifted from `openssl x509 -text` output captured
   at fixture-creation time. The hard-coded constants are the external
   oracle; the test must not use the path-builder to derive them.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Three DER fixtures committed.
- [ ] Generation steps documented in `tests/fixtures/generate.sh` so
      regeneration is reproducible.
- [ ] One integration test verifying AKI-correct selection.
- [ ] Test fails (with a clear message) if AKI handling is regressed.

## Depends on

PKIX-xj81.1 (shared generator + helpers).
title: pkix-path-builder: bridge CA cross-cert AKI disambiguation fixture+test
